concept: Balancing discipline with rest — recognizing when pushing through is wisdom and when it's harm
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic scenario where an adult is genuinely depleted (physically or mentally) but has a strong habit of pushing through regardless
exercise.reflection_prompt: How do you tell the difference between quitting and genuinely needing rest?
exercise.practice: Adult identifies real signals that distinguish healthy rest from avoidance

assessment.success_marker: adult names concrete, specific signals rather than a vague 'listen to your body' statement
